items.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>We introduce and investigate a simple model of conditional quantum dynamics. It allows for a discussion of the information‐theoretic aspects of quantum measurements, decoherence, and environment‐induced superselection (einselection).</jats:p>
title: Einselection and decoherence from an information theory perspective
